definitions.explanation: The sugar and starch components in food that serve as the body's primary energy source. In nutritional contexts, refers specifically to digestible carbohydrates excluding dietary fiber.

examples.japanese: {糖質|とうしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えている→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{糖質|とうしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧です。
examples.english: This food product is low in carbohydrates.

examples.japanese: {糖質|とうしつ}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{流行|はや}っている→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
examples.english: Low-carb diets have been popular recently.

notes:
USAGE:
{糖質|とうしつ} is the term commonly seen on Japanese nutrition labels and in diet-related discussions. It refers to digestible carbohydrates (sugars and starches), as opposed to ⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧ (dietary fiber).

NUTRITION LABEL NOTE:
Japanese food labels list ⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧ (total carbohydrates) which equals {糖質|とうしつ} + ⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糖質|とうしつ}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (carb restriction, low-carb)
- {糖質|とうしつ}⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧ (sugar-free/low-carb — used on product labels)
- {糖質|とうしつ}{量|りょう} (carbohydrate content)

RELATED NUTRITION TERMS:
- ⟦{脂質|ししつ}→脂質：11092_shishitsu⟧ (lipids, fats)
- たんぱく⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (protein)
- ⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧ (total carbohydrates, including fiber)
